title: Canonical finite-page maps from incoming-alpha graded quotients
statement:
Let $X$ be a type-zero exact couple in an abelian category [def-sp-exact-couple], with the lower-half-plane bounds at $a$, and let $L$ be its limiting subobjects [def-sp-convergence], equal to the cycles and boundaries at the sharp bound $\max(2,q-a+2,p+1)$. Suppose $\iota_r:D_r\to D$ is the recursively composed derived-D inclusion with $\iota_0=1$, $F_A^pD^{0,n}$ is the incoming alpha image for $p\ge0$ [def-sp-filtration], and $F_H=F_A.image(c_n)$ for invertible $c_n$ [def-sp-image-filtration]. For $p\ge0$, set $R=\max(p+3,q-a+2)$, $u=p-R+2$, $v=q+R-2$. The alpha iterate $\lambda:D^{0,p+q}\to D^{u,v}$ is invertible and induces an invertible lift of $F_A^p$ to $D_{R-2}^{u,v}$. The derived $g$ induces an isomorphism $\psi:\operatorname{gr}^pF_A\to E_R^{p,q}$. Transport along $c$ induces $\mathrm{gr}(c)$ and the step map, and stable cycles and boundaries induce $E_R^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}$. All these maps commute with their image inclusions and cokernel projections; their composite is the comparison $\Theta:\operatorname{gr}^pF_H\to E_\infty^{p,q}$. The exact index transports and all eight map equations are part of the interface below.

proof.text: For p>=0 construct lambda as the specified alpha iterate with its endpoint transport. Exactness makes alpha invertible at every nonpositive first index: f has zero source, so its image (the kernel of alpha) is bottom; g has zero target, so its kernel (the image of alpha) is top. Mono and full image give IsIso. Induct on the alpha-iterate length to obtain IsIso lambda.

Apply finitePage_image_lift to the prescribed incoming-alpha filtration and lambda. This supplies the invertible lift and its equation with inc. Then apply finitePage_graded_quotient to obtain psi and its quotient projection equation.

Use hFH to identify each target filtration step with the image of the source step under the invertible c. Subobject.isoOfMkEq gives step isomorphisms commuting with the inclusions. Cancel the target inclusion to obtain the square for the adjacent-step maps. cokernel.mapIso gives grc, and cokernel.π_desc gives the cStep projection equation.

The chosen R dominates max(2,q-a+2,p+1). Apply halfPlane_sharp_bounds and hL to obtain hZ and hB. The tower projection is epi with kernel equal to its boundary inclusion. Abelian.epiDesc and cokernel.desc construct inverse maps between this finite page and the corresponding cokernel, with inverse identities proved by epi cancellation. Use cokernel.mapIso on hZ and hB to transport that cokernel to pageInfinity, retaining the projection equation.

Define Theta as grc.symm followed by psi followed by stable. Introduce all eight witnesses and combine their proved equations; the equation for Theta is reflexive. The entire original signature is unchanged, including p=0 and q<a.
